notes: System records are separated from bare Jetson module records because carrier-board power input, networking, storage, camera interfaces, thermals and pricing materially affect deployment suitability.
TOPS are NVIDIA/Seeed platform figures and depend on datatype and sparsity; they are not equivalent to LLM tokens per second.
Model-size practicality is guidance only; runtime overhead, KV cache, context length and software version affect fit.
Bandwidth-per-watt values are derived from module memory bandwidth divided by maximum module power and are not measured whole-system efficiency.

hardware.operating_temperature: -20C to 60C in 25W mode; -20C to 55C in MAXN mode with supported active heatsink, per current Seeed wiki
hardware.model_size_practicality: Well suited to 7B-14B quantized models and selected ~20B-30B-class quantized models when weights, runtime overhead and KV cache fit in 32GB unified memory. Long context and multimodal pipelines reduce available weight capacity.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: CUDA/TensorRT and llama.cpp paths support reduced-precision inference depending on model/runtime. GGUF support is backend/model dependent; TensorRT formats are not interchangeable with GGUF.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Strong compact CUDA edge node where industrial I/O, 10GbE and direct battery/vehicle DC input matter. The 32GB memory ceiling limits the largest single-node models but enables substantially more than common 8-16GB Jetson devices.
hardware.physical_constraints: Sustained MAXN operation requires appropriate active cooling. Whole-system power exceeds bare-module power once storage, carrier-board I/O, cameras and peripherals are included.

pricing.note: Seeed catalog showed J5011 with GMSL at a US$2,199 special price, down from US$2,899.

hardware.operating_temperature: -20C to 60C in 25W mode; -20C to 55C in MAXN mode with supported active heatsink, per current Seeed wiki
hardware.model_size_practicality: 64GB unified memory makes many 30B-class quantized models comfortable and can fit selected 70B-class models at aggressive 4-bit-class quantization, subject to runtime/KV-cache/context overhead. Multimodal models and long contexts reduce usable weight capacity.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: CUDA/TensorRT and llama.cpp paths support reduced-precision inference depending on model/runtime. GGUF support is backend/model dependent; TensorRT formats are not interchangeable with GGUF.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: One of the stronger compact/off-grid CUDA systems for large local models because 64GB unified memory is combined with 204.8GB/s bandwidth, 10GbE and wide-range DC input. Throughput remains memory-bandwidth constrained versus modern discrete HBM/GDDR GPUs.
hardware.physical_constraints: Sustained MAXN operation requires appropriate active cooling. Whole-system power exceeds bare-module power once NVMe, carrier-board I/O, cameras and peripherals are included.

pricing.note: Seeed catalog showed J5012 with GMSL at a US$3,399 special price, down from US$4,699.
